capabilities: Record income, expenses, and transfers as frontmatter-marked notes
Show balance, category breakdown, and cash-flow overview
Plan future income, expenses, and transfers with a yearly heatmap
Track personal debts with linked repayment plans and an archive
Import and export all finance data as an Excel workbook
extras: Amounts are displayed only in Russian rubles; currency conversion is not supported. The README warns to back up the vault before category migrations or manual frontmatter edits. The manifest notes the plugin has not been reviewed by Obsidian staff. Support is offered via Telegram, Boosty, and YouTube.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to track money, account balances, or spending plans, so users would have to build it manually from notes.

relations.evidence: through the optional Person Network connector, by a linked person note

summary: Personal finance tracker that stores income, expenses, accounts, transfers, plans, and debts as Markdown notes with YAML frontmatter.
